The logo: H5 with more air and more room

Holger, 27 Sep: H5 is the closest; it should be a bit further from the bottom line and a bit further from the card. So World of moves up from Card Games, and the whole block moves out from the card with both starts still the same distance from its edge. Five rows step the two amounts, two of them move one thing only, and H5 is kept as it was for the comparison. The keepers stay as they are. Every row has a number and a name (say “I2”). Each row: the logo at 64px, then the site’s bar at a desktop width with the logo 32px tall, and a phone with it 24px tall.

The rows step the two amounts, and two of them move one thing only.
